description: Read jobs, tasks, documents and contacts; create and manage customer and vendor accounts.

jobtread_new_account_trigger.description: Runs for each new account in JobTread. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, createdAt
